When I was young, the shaman's grandmother said, "Your mate is the Dragon King!"  
 'Shinhae', who waited for her fate at a single word and missed the wedding date.  Eventually, she is admitted to her marriage village.  Then one day, she meets 'Yunje Kim', a scholar among scholars who jumped out of the river, and he is convinced that he is her dragon king.  But this man is a little strange.  If you don't read a book even for a day, you'll lose your writing...? (MTL)
